svg.text: Differential CDAC - exact capacitor weights and switching
Cu = 5 fF | sum(weights + dummy) = 256 Cu = 1.28 pF per side | ideal schematic capacitors
One bottom-plate selector, per bit and per side
Each of its 3 TGs: NMOS W=3 um + PMOS W=3 um; L=30 nm.
Sampling TGs: 2 parallel copies per side, Wn/Wp = 6/6 um effective.
Compact controller holds v0 LOW: bit0 is decided, but its final DAC switch is unnecessary.
All 18 capacitors remain present. Reference selection uses matching net labels; wires to shared VCM/REF rails are omitted for clarity.
